text:
maya: Quick sync — final headline test for next Wed's webinar. Need 4 variants to A/B in email + landing page + SFDC routing. Angle options: serving-first inference vs cost-first cloud APIs. Who can draft?

sam: I can draft. Short candidates to start: 1) 'Predictable inference, less guesswork' 2) 'Ship LLM features with consistent latency' 3) 'Lower token spend without sacrificing quality' 4) 'Unified runtime for reliable LLM serving'

jordan: Love 2 & 4. Can we try a benchmark hook too? e.g. 'lower unit cost than stock cloud endpoints for latency‑sensitive apps' — careful with explicit multipliers. @lee do we have legal/bench ok?

lee: Prefer avoiding explicit "2x/5x" in customer-facing unless research signs off. Use phrasing like 'lower unit cost' or 'up to X, see benchmark PDF' with footnote. Also add note: include quantization and model family details in appendix.

ana: (typo: ana) Sales ask: need a one‑liner for SDR outreach that maps to routing rules. Proposed: 'Redwood makes inference predictable & economical at scale.' We'll route inbound > $10k MRR to AE queue. Also need short battlecard bullets vs managed cloud: 1) graceful fallbacks 2) private deployment option 3) per-route SLOs.

maya: Good. For the landing page: 3 CTAs — request demo, download benchmark PDF, join live Q&A. Also want a tiny pre-demo checklist to qualify attendees.

sam: Draft checklist for slide 3: - workload profile (conversational vs retrieval) - latency SLO (p95 target) - token budget - model family preference. Also putting together 4 headline variants by EOD.

jordan: Webinar format idea: 25min talk + 15min live micro‑benchmarks (30min total). Show a live compare on a representative convo workload and then Q&A. Ops-bot, can you warm a canary for the live demo?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for demo harness deployed to staging at 2024-11-02T10:12Z :white_check_mark: Warmup scripts queued.

maya: Perf messaging: emphasize 'unified runtime' + 'fallbacks' — that differentiates us from infra vendors who only provide an endpoint and from cloud APIs that hide deployment controls.

sam: Combining: headline candidate — 'Unified runtime for predictable, cost-aware LLM serving.' Subject line candidate: 'Cut inference surprises—ship reliably'

ana: :thumbsup: Running a 1K-person subject line test next hour. Also prepping battlecard bullets for SDRs: routing policies, KV caching, per-route token cost breakdowns, dedicated pools.

lee: Add 'quantization recommendations & supported kernels' to battlecard — infra teams ask that first. Also include a short FAQ: 'When to choose Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private' with 3 one‑liners.

maya: Action items: sam finalize 4 headline variants by EOD; jordan coordinate claim language with research; ana set AE routing rule; lee add quant notes to battlecard; i'll prep CTAs and landing copy. Meeting tomorrow 9am PT to lock creative.

sam: Noted. Quick example routing snippet for docs/ops team: ```yaml
route: 
  priority: dedicated
  fallback: hosted
  model_override: redwood-7b-quant
```

jordan: One more — in the webinar we'll surface a short 'how we measure' slide: dataset profile, seq length, concurrency, and batching strategy. Keeps claims transparent.

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone — small, focused test set. We'll iterate after the subject line results. :sparkles:
